description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector class in a macOS application. It tests the injection of session-related menu items, handling of control channel connection state, and usage of various provider summaries within menu structures.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjectorTests
classes.description: A suite of unit tests verifying the behavior of MenuSessionsInjector, including menu item injection, session row handling, and cost usage display.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests if the injector correctly determines the insertion point for session rows in the menu.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Verifies that the injector inserts a disconnected message indicator when the control channel is not connected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Checks if session rows are correctly injected into the menu when the control channel is connected.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the cost usage submenu displays the correct data and does not rely on the injector delegate.
